title: Extreme Computation | Arithmetic Rigidity Explained
desc:
Is there a mathematical "wall" that caps the potential of all human software?

In this deep dive, Sethu Iyer explores the provocative theory of Arithmetic Rigidity. We often assume software is infinitely malleable—that with enough code and servers, we can build anything. But what if the very fabric of mathematics imposes a boundary that only one structure can survive?

We’re unpacking why prime numbers are not just schoolbook curiosities, but the only "computational substrate" in the universe capable of scaling infinitely without collapsing. From the fatal rounding error of a Patriot Missile to the music of the Riemann Zeta function, we explore the four impossible constraints that define the limits of what can be built.

The Closure Phenomenon: Why the design space for perfect computation violently collapses.

The Graveyard of Alternatives: Why hashes, floating points, and quasi-crystals fail at scale.

title: Truth as Thermal History
desc:
Explore a radical new perspective on the fundamental laws governing our reality. This video dives into the "Four-Step Engine of Complexity"—a universal cycle found in physics, cognition, and computation. We examine the concept of TATH (Truth as Thermal History), suggesting that mathematics isn't just discovered but "condensed" from infinite possibilities. From the unpredictable turbulence of prime numbers to the multi-dimensional origami of the Adele Ring, discover how complexity emerges from creases and folds rather than raw material. We also take a look at Shunya Bar, a deep-tech lab in India building the tools—like Nitrosat and BAHA—to map this new frontier where math and reality melt together.

title: Introducing NitroSAT: Powerful linear-time MaxSAT approximation engine
desc:
NitroSAT is a new computational engine that reinterprets the MaxSAT problem as a continuous process of thermodynamic relaxation. 

How It Works – From Math to Code
State as a field on the hyperbolic disk.
Compute gradients of the free energy (kinetic + potential + entropy).
Diffuse via a heat‑kernel approximation (no expensive eigen‑decomposition).
Detect topological fractures (Betti‑1 cycles) and perform branch‑aware holonomy annealing.
Iterate until a global optimum or a high‑quality approximate solution is found.

desc:

From doubling revenue in spectrum auctions to finding Ramsey theory witnesses in under a second on a laptop, BAHA isn't just an optimizer—it's a diagnostic oracle that reveals the hidden structure of reality.

title: Navokoj: Deterministic, Time-Bounded Constraint Solving at Scale
desc:
Navokoj is a novel constraint intelligence engine platform designed to solve astronomically large discrete spaces with deterministic, time-bounded performance. While classical SAT solvers often struggle with search explosions and unpredictable runtimes, Navokoj leverages principles from statistical mechanics and arithmetic symmetry breaking to deliver a scalable, reliable solution.

In this video, we go beyond standard Boolean logic to explore the "geometry of constraint satisfaction." We discuss how C* algebras, Gibbs states, and the Riemann zeta function can be unified into a high-performance framework for constraint solving at scale.

title: Primes as Curvature Defects: A Topological Perspective on Number Theory
desc:
What if prime numbers are not just isolated integers, but structural "defects" in a geometric landscape?

In this presentation, Sethu Iyer explores a novel topological framework for number theory, shifting the perspective from Boolean variables to an arithmetic landscape where global phase coherence and curvature play a central role. By examining the relationship between local inconsistency ("frustration") and measurable curvature, this research provides a new lens through which to view primality, the Riemann Zeta function, and the profinite solenoid.

Key Concepts Explored:

    Frustration = Curvature: How local pairwise inconsistencies predict global impossibility.

    The Spectral Portrait of Primality: Using Fourier analysis and the Riemann Zeta function to understand the integer terrain.

    Topological Defects: Primes as irreducible features in the profinite solenoid.

    Geodesic Divergence: Linking prime number density to negative curvature and local geometry.

Presented by: Sethu Iyer
